protocol: exit 0 = PASS, 1 = FAIL, 77 = SKIP (a line 'SKIP: <why>'), anything else = ERROR; a PASS that ran no checks is an ERROR. Run by bin/run-suites.cjs.

groups.ci: Runs on a clean site: WordPress, this plugin, DX Base and Twenty Twenty-Five, no content (wp-env in CI). Every one must PASS there (run-suites --strict).
groups.local: Needs what a working site holds: the American Restoration theme (the team's template, its blocks and palette) or designs already imported. Run on prodtest2; SKIP where the thing is not there.
groups.manual: Needs a client archive or a project on this machine, or a live crawl; run by hand (see the file's header).
groups.paid: Asks a real AI provider (costs money): run by hand with --group paid on a site whose Settings hold a key.
groups.browser: Node scripts that drive a browser against a site; run by hand with the site's address (see the file's header).
